name: Rubber FM bass
desc: Rubbery FM bass in D#/Eb minor: near-octave fmh(2.01) gives an elastic bounce with a fast bite envelope, a syncopated octave-jump cell with odd accents, and a 4-cycle i-i-VI-VII harmonic drift that keeps recontextualising the accents. Sidechain-feel saw pump, 8-32 cycle filter tide, octave-up phrase-end fill at peak.

code.full: note("[eb1 ~ eb1 eb2 ~ eb1 eb2 eb1]").add(note("<0 0 -4 -2>")).add(note(${root})).s("sine").fm(${fmi}).fmh(${ratio}).fmattack(.005).fmdecay(.12).decay(.25).sustain(.15).release(.05).lpf(sine.range(${cut}*.7, ${cut}*1.5).slow(16)).lpq(4).shape(.3).gain(saw.range(${gain}*.5, ${gain}).fast(4)).room(.1).orbit(3).play()
code.peak: note("[eb1 [~ eb1] eb1 eb2 [eb1 eb1] gb1 [~ eb2] bb1]").add(note("<0 0 -4 -2>")).add(note(${root})).s("sine").fm(${fmi}).fmh(${ratio}).fmattack(.003).fmdecay(.1).decay(.22).sustain(.12).release(.05).lpf(sine.range(${cut}, ${cut}*2).slow(8)).lpq(5).shape(.35).gain(saw.range(${gain}*.55, ${gain}).fast(4)).lastOf(8, x=>x.add(note(12))).room(.1).orbit(3).play()
